response.rationale: Several T1 meta-analyses (Norris 2000, Spada 2010, Goo 2015, Kang 2019) consistently find explicit instruction outperforms implicit, but caveats weaken the claim: outcome tests may be biased toward explicit knowledge (Doughty 2003), implicit instruction held up better on delayed tests (Kang 2019), effects are smaller on spontaneous speech, and Krashen's monitor view and the unresolved interface debate (talk:20) leave "predicts proficiency" short of fully established.
